mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO join_task_result (join_task_id, account, account_id, link, status, dispatch_state, next_execute_at, command_id, attempt_no, reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{r.joinTaskId}, #{r.account}, #{r.accountId}, #{r.link}, #{r.status}, COALESCE(#{r.dispatchState}, CASE WHEN #{r.status} = 'PENDING' THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'TERMINAL' END), #{r.nextExecuteAt}, #{r.commandId}, #{r.attemptNo}, #{r.reason}, #{r.createdAt}, #{r.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM join_task_result WHERE join_task_id = #{joinTaskId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM join_task_result WHERE join_task_id = #{joinTaskId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE join_task_result SET status = 'SUCCESS', reason = '', group_jid = #{groupJid}, joined_at = COALESCE(joined_at, #{updatedAt}), updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.id AS resultId FROM join_task_result r JOIN join_task t ON t.id = r.join_task_id AND t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.dispatch_state = 'WAITING' AND r.next_execute_at IS NOT NULL AND r.next_execute_at <= #{now} ORDER BY r.next_execute_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.* FROM join_task_result r JOIN join_task t ON t.id = r.join_task_id AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.id IN #{id} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.dispatch_state = 'WAITING' AND r.next_execute_at IS NOT NULL AND r.next_execute_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM join_task_result active WHERE active.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND active.join_task_id = r.join_task_id AND active.account_id = r.account_id AND active.status = 'PENDING' AND active.dispatch_state = 'SUBMITTED' ) ORDER BY r.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE join_task_result r JOIN ( SELECT MIN(id) AS id FROM join_task_result WHERE join_task_id = #{joinTaskId} AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'PENDING' AND dispatch_state = 'WAITING' GROUP BY account_id ) first_row ON first_row.id = r.id SET r.next_execute_at = #{now}, r.updated_at = #{now} WHERE r.join_task_id = #{joinTaskId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.dispatch_state = 'WAITING' AND r.next_execute_at IS NULL

UPDATE join_task_result SET dispatch_state = 'WAITING', command_id = NULL, next_execute_at = #{nextExecuteAt}, reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND dispatch_state = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE join_task_result SET status = 'SUCCESS', dispatch_state = 'TERMINAL', reason = '', group_jid = #{groupJid}, joined_at = COALESCE(joined_at, #{now}), next_execute_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND dispatch_state = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE join_task_result SET status = 'FAILED', dispatch_state = 'TERMINAL', reason = #{reason}, next_execute_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND dispatch_state IN ('WAITING', 'SUBMITTED')
mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.id AS resultId, r.command_id AS commandId, r.attempt_no AS attemptNo FROM join_task_result r JOIN protocol_command_outbox o ON o.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND o.aggregate_type = 'JOIN_TASK_RESULT' AND o.aggregate_id = r.id AND o.command_id = r.command_id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.dispatch_state = 'SUBMITTED' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = #{deadStatus} ORDER BY o.updated_at, o.id LIMIT #{limit}
